about: The source model of a NIfTI-1 or NIfTI-2 single file (spec/zarrify/nifti.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/nifti.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, the table of data types, and the roles the file, its dimensions, its data type, its voxel offset and its voxel data play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the NIfTI convention's layout (spec/zarrify/nifti.md §7.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/nifti.md#71-header>). The parser checks them in this order; the extension chain never rejects; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

datatypes.about: datatype: Zarr data type, bitpix, samples per voxel

unsupported.about: datatypes the profile names and rejects

elements.about: The IR of a NIfTI file. E is the file's byte order (< or >), L the header's length (348 or 540), v the voxel offset, B the voxel data's size.

header.type: the header as one record, a field per field of spec/zarrify/nifti.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/nifti.md#2-the-header> in its order: numbers Ei2, Ei4, Ei8, u1, Ef4, Ef8 (arrays for T[k]), text cstr[k]

extensions/<i>.type: {esize:Ei4,ecode:Ei4,data:cstr[d]} for a text ecode (4, 6, 8, 32, 44), {esize:Ei4,ecode:Ei4,data:bytes[d]} otherwise, {esize:Ei4,ecode:Ei4} when d is 0 (d = esize - 8)
extensions/<i>.extent: the extension, when the extender's first byte is not 0, in chain order

voxels.form: {geometry: {data_type, samples}, codec: {endian}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}; of a gzipped file, codec: {encoding: gzip, endian, skip: v}
voxels.extent: (v, B); of a gzipped file, the whole file, and no other element

gaps/<offset>.about: padding, bytes the chain does not hold, bytes after the voxel data; of a header-and-image pair, whose elements lie in the objects of a store IR, the bytes after the chain, and those before and after the voxels

constraints.message: file too short for a {length}-byte NIfTI-{version} header

given.d6: the size of dimension 6 (1 beyond n)

constraints.message: color data with a fifth dimension

given.total: B = X Y Z T C b, exactly

constraints.message: the {total_shown}-byte voxel data at {vox} is outside the {size}-byte file

given.named: whether its name ends in .hdr or .HDR

constraints.message: the header file "{key}" of a NIfTI pair is not named .hdr, which is how its image file's name is found
the header file "{key}" of {size} bytes is more than 16777216, which the mirror holds
the {total_shown}-byte voxel data is more than 2^53 - 1 bytes
the image file "{key}" does not exist

given.inflated: the bytes of the stream's start that inflated
given.isize: the size the gzip trailer records

constraints.message: the gzip stream ends or breaks in the header's first {first} bytes

the gzip trailer records a stream of {isize} bytes modulo 2^32, not the {stream_shown} of the header and the voxel data: bytes after the voxel data, or a file of several gzip members, which a chunk cannot decode
